claim: With a back-buffer composer, redirecting only the blit's source to a clean copy can work when a clean copy exists at blit time and nothing reads the buffer or screen.

evidence.text: Redirecting only the blit's source to a clean copy gave identical game memory with one small hook (at 0xAE40: pointers := clean copies, blit, pointers put back); needs a clean copy in memory at blit time and a game that reads neither buffer nor screen.
evidence.quote: Keeping the back buffer intact and redirecting only the blit's source gave identical game memory with one small hook
